question: Select the most appropriate option for blank 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"beautiful."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Beautiful"** means attractive, pleasing to the eye, or aesthetically pleasing. (सुंदर, ख़ूबसूरत, आकर्षक; रमणीय, प्रियकर) • **Example**: *The sunset was so **beautiful**__ that it took my breath away.* • It is an adjective that describes the appearance of something or someone. • The correct answer is Option 2. • **Correct passage**: Nainital has a __**beautiful**__ lake. Tourists come from far and wide to ______ 2 ______ boating here. There is a skating place behind it. People who skate here say that the ride seems to go round with them. Evenings are also pleasant here. The ______ 3 ______ of the electric lights looks as if they are dancing in the ripples of the lake. Truly, Nainital is an ______ 4 ______ city of ______ 5 ______ beauty.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Sagacious** means wise or shrewd. (सही निर्णय क्षमता या समझ वाला; बुद्धिमान, दूरदर्शी, विवेकशील) • **Pleasing** means satisfying or enjoyable. (सुखकर और संतोषप्रद) • **Alluring** means attractive or enticing. (रहस्‍यमय ढंग से लुभावना व मोहक) 43:Td7a, The correct answer is **"enjoy."**
